test_title: PYST 57: RRB Group D - GS (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about phloem is correct?

options.text: Phloem transports minerals from roots to leaves.
Phloem transports food from leaves to other parts.
Phloem is made entirely of dead cells.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Phloem transports food from leaves to other parts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Phloem** is a complex permanent tissue in **vascular plants** responsible for the transport of organic nutrients, particularly **sucrose**, produced during **photosynthesis**.
 
• **Statement 1**: **Phloem** transports minerals from roots to leaves. This is incorrect because the transport of **water and minerals** from the **roots** to the **leaves** is the primary function of the **Xylem** tissue. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
 
• **Statement 2**: **Phloem** transports food from leaves to other parts. This is the fundamental role of phloem, often referred to as **translocation**. It carries synthesized food from the **source** (leaves) to the **sink** (roots, fruits, and growing tips). ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
